post.text:
THE NEW OPENCLAW UPDATE IS GOATED

- Kimi K2.5 is now free

- Agents run without paid APIs

- Skills can be saved and reused

- Everything runs faster

https://t.co/76MyEcuDd7

Kimi K2.5 is free via NVIDIA's hosted inference (no paid API required)

- Sign up or log in to an NVIDIA Developer account 

- Go to the Kimi K2.5 model page on NVIDIA's platform

- Generate a free API key directly from there

- Use the key in OpenClaw with NVIDIA's base URL

- Runs on NVIDIA's GPUs at no cost for prototyping and testing

comments.text:
Unpaid AI usage is problematic. When large corporations provide what is essentially a loss leader it undermines markets so that other players in the space that require a profit to provide you the service cannot be in the market. It is a competitive practice that is anti competion and leaves only the top corporations standing. 

Unfortunately this kind of warfare on a global scale is near impossible to stop because if you penalize your people while others are subsidized you effect the consumer by making them less powerful in addition to them have less power of choice.
